name: Nathan Bland

Added Python and FastAPI features for query filtering, multi-source data enrichment, session preferences, and real-time service updates.
Implemented OIDC and SSO integrations, WebSocket updates, and session-expiry handling across internal applications.
Wrote Vitest, Testing Library, and pytest coverage alongside feature work and maintained frontend quality and build tooling.
